questions.enonce_markdown: (b) Given that $2A=B$. Find the values of $x$ and $y$. *[7 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Two matrices are equal when their corresponding entries are equal:

$\begin{pmatrix}6&2x+2\\4&10\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}6&14\\4&y-x\end{pmatrix}$.

Top right entry: $2x+2=14$, so $2x=12$ and $x=6$.

Bottom right entry: $y-x=10$, so $y=10+x=10+6=16$.

Check: $2A=\begin{pmatrix}6&14\\4&10\end{pmatrix}$ and $B=\begin{pmatrix}6&14\\4&16-6\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}6&14\\4&10\end{pmatrix}$.

**Answer: $x=6$ and $y=16$.**
